title: Consultor SAP IBP Pleno # 981152'
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender nosso cliente no segmento na área da Tecnologia.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Liderar projetos SAP IBP desde o levantamento de requisitos até a entrega da solução.
  • Configurar e implementar módulos do IBP.
  • Preferencial: IBP for Demand (Previsão), IBP for Response (Baseado em Pedidos).
  • Desejável: IBP for Supply, Otimização de Inventário, S&OP.
  • Realizar análise de aderência (Fit/Gap), design funcional, configuração, testes e cutover.
  • Treinar usuários-chave e apoiar a transferência de conhecimento.


O que você precisa ter

  • 4–6 anos de experiência em implementação do SAP IBP (preferencial).
  • Forte conhecimento dos processos do IBP: Planejamento de Suprimentos e Demanda, S&OP, Planejamento de Inventário.
  • Experiência prática em design, configuração e construção do IBP.
  • Mentalidade voltada para resolução de problemas, senso de responsabilidade e capacidade de trabalhar de forma independente.
  • Fortes habilidades de comunicação com equipes técnicas.
  • Experiência em Cadeia de Suprimentos/Logística é um diferencial.
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório).


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
FBS is a global trading and investment platform focused on users.

The mission of FBS is to create the most convenient tool on the market for fast financial transactions, investing, and trading with quick adaptation to the user's preferences and pursuing interests.

Our team consists of more than 450 professionals from 15 countries. As for the company’s geographic coverage, FBS established its main regional presence in South-East Asia, Europe, South America, Africa, and Australia.


You will:


  • Provide prompt and effective assistance in chats and tickets, responding to customer inquiries based on the knowledge base and training materials.
  • Maintain KPI levels in accordance with department standards.
  • Stay informed about company policies, announcements, and updates to ensure effective communication with customers.
  • Adhere to assigned working hours and demonstrate punctuality in scheduled shifts.
  • Identify and report system errors or service disruptions to the team lead or mid/senior agents in the absence of the team lead.
  • Escalate complex customer issues to the team lead or mid/senior agents to ensure proper follow-up and resolution.


It's a match if:


  • You speak English, Spanish and Portuguese fluently.
  • You have excellent communication skills and quick and efficient problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent customer service skills: you are empathetic, accurate, compassionate, responsive, resourceful, and conscientious. You can find an approach to all types of people.
  • You are ready to work 40 hours per week with a shift schedule (flexible hours).


Nice to have:


  • Work experience in customer support.
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.


We offer:


  • Expertise development. Work in a team with top-notch professionals in their field. Opportunities for networking, exchange of experience, and internal and external training at the company's expense.
  • You get to affect the result. There’s no bureaucracy or the need for a large number of approvals. The processes within the team are subject to change – you can easily control their development and alignment of global operations.
  • Comfortable conditions. Remote work and friendly atmosphere. Rich corporate life.
  • Stability. Competitive official salary, advanced benefits system (medicine, additional pay on sick leave, etc.).

title: Podcast Assistant
description:
About Sofia Health: Sofia Health is a fast-growing marketplace dedicated to connecting clients with wellness providers across various disciplines. Our mission is to make health and wellness services accessible and engaging for everyone. The Sofia Unfiltered podcast is our platform to highlight the journeys, insights, and expertise of health and wellness professionals, amplifying their stories to inspire and educate a broader audience.


Role Overview: We're looking for a creative and organized Podcast Production Assistant to support our production team with various aspects of podcast creation. This role will be instrumental in the entire production process, from pre-production through post-production, and will also require expertise in email writing to promote episodes, coordinate with guests, and keep our audience engaged. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone passionate about storytelling, health and wellness, and digital media.


Responsibilities:

  • Assist with the day-to-day production of the Sofia Unfiltered podcast, including scheduling, script assistance, and audio/video editing support
  • Coordinate guest outreach, scheduling, and follow-ups to ensure a smooth guest experience
  • Draft show notes, guest bios, and key talking points for the host
  • Upload episodes, titles, descriptions, and assets to Spotify, YouTube, Apple Podcasts, and hosting platforms
  • Track episode releases, metrics, and guest promotion deliverables
  • Maintain podcast calendar and content pipeline
  • Research new guests that align with our mission and audience
  • Organize clips for promotion or pass timestamps to our editor
  • Ensure guest intake forms and promotional materials are received
  • Coordinating with internal teams to share content and updates
  • Assist with research, including background on guests and trending wellness topics
  • Support social media promotion of podcast episodes
  • Manage episode timelines, deadlines, and organization within our content calendar


Qualifications:

  • Strong writing skills, with experience in email marketing or professional email communications
  • Background in media, communications, journalism, or related field preferred
  • Experience with podcast production, audio editing software (e.g., Adobe Audition, Audacity), or video editing tools is a plus
  • Knowledge of health and wellness topics and trends is a bonus
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines in a remote environment
  • Enthusiasm for storytelling and podcasting, with a creative mindset

title: Translation Quality Control Specialist
description:
Quality Assurance Analyst


**This is an administrative, non-technical position focused on document review and proofreading.**


LegalSight is a dynamic, innovative, and growing organization. We like to have fun while taking our work very seriously. Quality control is central to LegalSight and a great quality team member is dedicated with a high degree of attention to detail!


The Quality Assurance Analyst will provide quality assessments of language translation projects in order to ensure we meet our client’s quality standards.


Key Elements of the Role:

  • This is a fully remote position.
  • Working hours during the 30-day training period will be Monday - Friday 10:00PM - 6:00AM Brazil time. Once training is complete, working hours will change to Monday - Friday 10:00AM - 6:00PM Brazil time.
  • Fluency in spoken and written English is required for this role as you would be collaborating with and supporting team members internationally.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Complete quality review of translations.
  • Collaborate with Project Management Team to clarify project parameters.
  • Communicate effectively with vendors world-wide in order to reconcile any found errors.
  • Implement process improvements using available technology solutions.


Essential Skills:

  • Highly-focused, detail-oriented, and client-centric mindset
  • Capable of setting and meeting deadlines
  • Ability to manage time effectively
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Proven problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work well in both independent and highly collaborative settings
  • Ability to excel in fast-paced work environment
  • High degree of proficiency in relevant computer skills (MS Office)

title: Trust Accountant Support Trainer
description:
Trust Accountant Support Trainer


Location: Brazil, fully remote

Type: Full-time, 8hours/day

Availability: ASAP to 2 weeks

Rate: 5,000 BRL to 14,000 BRL per month

Level: Junior to Senior

Setup: PJ/Consultancy

Industry: Hospitality/Accommodation/Rental

Experience:

  • Accounting or Bookkeeping (Required)
  • Onboarding Clients to understand Accounting

Equipment: Needs to have own machine, equipment not provided



Job Description

Do you have a strong accounting background but want more variety than balance sheets and reports? Do you enjoy teaching others, solving problems, and helping people succeed? If so, this role might be the perfect fit.

As a Software Accounting Trainer / Onboarding Specialist, you’ll play a key role in guiding new clients in the vacation rental industry through their onboarding process. You’ll ensure proper setup of taxes, fees, and trust accounting, and train clients on how to use the software system effectively to stay compliant and confident. This role blends accounting expertise with training, customer service, and problem-solving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding and transition sessions for new vacation rental clients, ensuring accurate accounting system setup.
  • Train clients via Zoom on all accounting functions within the system, including trust accounting.
  • Perform and review accounting tasks such as:
  • Bank and non-bank account reconciliations
  • Entering transactions and journal entries
  • Preparing Trial Balance and Trust reports
  • Reviewing client entries for errors and developing correction plans
  • Identify misplaced or invalid data, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolution.
  • Respond to support tickets and client calls promptly, providing clear, professional guidance.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through exceptional customer service.
  • Write and update knowledge base articles to support client and internal education.
  • Lead webinars and group training sessions for clients and staff on accounting best practices.
  • Document and analyze client questions and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Collaborate with instructional design and internal teams to create and improve training resources.
  • Participate in team meetings and internal projects, contributing to process improvements and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2–5 years of accounting or bookkeeping experience, preferably in property management or vacation rental industries.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles; trust accounting knowledge highly preferred.
  • Experience with accounting for vacation rentals, property management, or hospitality a strong plus.
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, and video conferencing tools (Zoom or equivalent).
  • Proven success in delivering excellent customer service.
  • Ability to communicate complex accounting concepts clearly to clients and colleagues.
  • Strong organizational skills, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Professional, polished, and engaging personality with an approachable teaching style.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment; quick learner and adaptable team player.


Why Join Us?

This role is ideal for accounting professionals who want to apply their technical expertise in a more dynamic, client-facing role. You’ll directly support vacation rental property managers by helping them master their accounting systems, stay in trust, and operate with confidence. At the same time, you’ll build skills in training, client success, and process improvement while working in one of the fastest-growing segments of the hospitality industry.

  • Participate in team meetings and internal projects, contributing to process improvements and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2–5 years of accounting or bookkeeping experience, preferably in property management or vacation rental industries.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles; trust accounting knowledge highly preferred.
  • Experience with accounting for vacation rentals, property management, or hospitality a strong plus.
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, and video conferencing tools (Zoom or equivalent).
  • Proven success in delivering excellent customer service.
  • Ability to communicate complex accounting concepts clearly to clients and colleagues.
  • Strong organizational skills, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Professional, polished, and engaging personality with an approachable teaching style.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment; quick learner and adaptable team player.


Why Join Us?

This role is ideal for accounting professionals who want to apply their technical expertise in a more dynamic, client-facing role. You’ll directly support vacation rental property managers by helping them master their accounting systems, stay in trust, and operate with confidence. At the same time, you’ll build skills in training, client success, and process improvement while working in one of the fastest-growing segments of the hospitality industry.

title: Especialista de Gamificação | CRM iGaming
description:
A RETEM é uma consultoria e BPO de CRM especializada em iGaming. Atuamos como braço estratégico e operacional de casas de apostas e cassinos online na América Latina, com foco nos quatro pilares que movem o setor: ativação, retenção, monetização e recuperação.


Já geramos centenas de milhões de reais em GGR impulsionando campanhas, jornadas e estratégias de relacionamento. Somos obcecados por performance, dados e experiência do jogador — e queremos quem compartilha dessa mesma visão.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Gamificação apaixonado por engajamento, mecânicas motivacionais e comportamento do jogador.


Responsabilidades

  • Planejar e operar mecânicas de gamificação (missões, metas, badges, ranking, loja de pontos).
  • Definir economia de pontos e regras de progressão por segmento.
  • Integrar gamificação às jornadas de onboarding, retenção e VIP.
  • Acompanhar KPIs de engajamento e ajustar loops motivacionais.


Requisitos

  • Experiência com gamificação aplicada a CRM.
  • Experiência com iGaming e análise de comportamento.
  • Capacidade analítica para calibrar incentivos.
  • Integração com Automação e Dados.


Diferenciais

  • Vivência em Smartico.
  • Conhecimento de behavioral design.
  • BI básico para leitura de impacto.
  • Espanhol ou inglês.


Envie seu currículo para com o assunto “Especialista de Gamificação – (Seu Nome)” .

title: Senior Backend Engineer - Ruby on Rails (remoto)
description:
Nosso time está buscando um Engenheiro de Software Sênior com foco em Ruby on Rails para um de nossos clientes voltados para Georastreamento, com foco em expansão da capacidade dos sistemas e melhoria contínua da nossa experiência de desenvolvimento. Atuamos com forte foco em GPS e Geolocalização , e nossa infraestrutura é baseada em nuvem (AWS), com construção de APIs tanto para uso interno quanto para parceiros de negócios.

O desafio é 100% remoto , modelo de contratação é CLT e inglês avançado em conversação é fundamental pois os interlocutores são internacionais.


Responsabilidades:

  • Ajudar no treinamento e mentoria de outros desenvolvedores, mantendo abertura para aprender com os colegas.
  • Participar de discussões de requisitos, arquitetura e design.
  • Colaborar na definição da arquitetura com foco na flexibilidade de curto prazo e ganhos sustentáveis de longo prazo.
  • Atuar como referência técnica com conhecimento sólido em design e arquitetura de software.
  • Projetar, implementar e testar sistemas de alta disponibilidade para:
  • Processamento de dados de telemetria, incluindo geolocalização;
  • Mapeamento e correlação de dados de localização;
  • Aplicação de regras com base em geofences (cercas virtuais) para envio de notificações;
  • Gestão de relacionamentos comerciais que permitam o compartilhamento de ativos;
  • Acesso seguro a interfaces web e APIs.
  • Apoiar o time na resolução de problemas e solicitações de clientes.
  • Utilizar a base de código atual para aprofundar o conhecimento sobre funcionalidades existentes.
  • Implementar soluções com foco em AWS e práticas DevOps.


Conhecimentos e Habilidades Necessárias:

  • Experiência em design e desenvolvimento de APIs, com preferência por conhecimento em GraphQL.
  • Experiência sólida com Ruby on Rails (diversas versões).
  • Conhecimento desejável em JavaScript, Typescript, Angular, React e Next.js.
  • Pelo menos 7 anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software.
  • Experiência com CI/CD, Gitlab, Docker, AWS e PostgreSQL.
  • Conhecimento em microserviços, micro frontends, automação de testes e revisão de código.
  • Experiência com sistemas transacionais de alto volume.
  • Ter trabalhado com tecnologias como Telemática, IoT ou voltadas para veículos será considerado um diferencial.
  • Experiência com produtos B2B SaaS.


Pré-requisitos Fundamentais:

  • Experiência sólida com design e desenvolvimento de APIs (GraphQL).
  • Conhecimento avançado em Ruby on Rails.
  • Capacidade de explicar e aplicar técnicas padrão de programação (OOP, funcional, etc.).
  • Capacidade de traduzir preocupações de negócio para o contexto tecnológico.
  • Experiência completa no ciclo de vida de aplicações em nuvem (deploy, testes, manutenção).
  • Capacidade de avaliar diferentes abordagens arquiteturais (monolito vs microserviços, por exemplo).
  • Domínio de versionamento de código (Git).
  • Entendimento sobre diferentes mecanismos de armazenamento de dados (PostgreSQL, Redis) e suas vantagens/desvantagens.
  • Vivência com sistemas baseados em mensagens (bus, streaming, pub/sub).
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Agile/Lean).


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com softwares GIS como PostGIS, shapefiles, KML, MapServer, OpenLayers.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento IoT.
  • Experiência com Kubernetes (EKS) e serviços AWS.
  • Background com dispositivos GPS ou sistemas embarcados.
  • Experiência com Docker, Kafka, Resque, serviços RESTful.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Terragrunt).


Formação e Experiência

  • 7+ anos de experiência com Ruby e/ou Ruby on Rails.
  • 5+ anos de experiência com AWS, PostgreSQL ou tecnologias similares.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolvimento e manutenção dos modelos regulatórios de risco de crédito (PD, LGD, EAD e Estágios IFRS9), garantindo aderência às normas IFRS9 e regulamentações do BACEN (Res. 4966, 229, 2682).
  • Ser responsável técnico pelas metodologias de provisionamento de perda esperada (ECL) da carteira de crédito, assegurando consistência entre o modelo, as bases de dados e as regras contábeis.
  • Estruturar e automatizar pipelines de cálculo de PD, LGD e EAD em ambiente Databricks (PySpark/SQL), integrando os modelos às bases de produção e garantindo rastreabilidade e governança.
  • Conduzir análises retroativas e de performance dos modelos (backtesting, estabilidade de variáveis, KS, AUC, PSI, curing rate, hazard e survival curves) para identificar desvios e propor evoluções metodológicas.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com as áreas de Crédito, Cobrança, Contabilidade, Financeiro e Risco, traduzindo necessidades do negócio em soluções analíticas robustas e sustentáveis.
  • Acompanhar práticas de mercado e evoluções regulatórias, propondo inovações que aumentem a eficiência do provisionamento e a precisão das estimativas de risco.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em modelagem de risco de crédito regulatória (PD, LGD, EAD e Estágios IFRS9).
  • Domínio técnico das normas IFRS9 e regulamentos BACEN (4966, 229, 2682).
  • Proficiência em Python (pandas, pyspark, scikit-learn) e SQL, com foco em manipulação e modelagem de grandes bases de dados.
  • Vivência com Databricks e Spark, preferencialmente em ambientes de produção (Delta Tables, workflows automatizados).
  • Sólida experiência em avaliação de performance de modelos (KS, AUC, PSI, estabilidade).
  • Conhecimento em versionamento, governança e documentação de modelos (MLflow, Git, Confluence).


Desejável

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, bancos digitais ou consultorias de risco regulatório.
  • Conhecimento prático de provisão contábil, roll rates, vintage analysis e estrutura de matrizes de transição.
  • Noções de LGD baseada em recuperação e fluxos de castigo (cash flow de perda).

title: Gerente de infraestrutura de TI
description:
Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital.

Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo:

Gerente de Projetos (Infraestrutura, Banco de Dados e Cibersegurança)


Buscamos um Gerente de Infraestrutura para atuar na gestão de iniciativas estratégicas envolvendo banco de dados, infraestrutura e cibersegurança.

Será responsável por planejar, coordenar e acompanhar todas as etapas dos projetos, garantindo entregas de alta qualidade dentro de prazos e orçamentos definidos.

Ter experiência comprovada em projetos de migração ou implantação de sistemas e implementação de processos baseados no ITIL.

Perfil desejado:

Profissional com visão técnica e estratégica, forte capacidade de gestão, comunicação clara e habilidade em coordenar equipes multidisciplinares.

Forte conhecimento em processos ITIL (se tiver experiência com implementação do ITIL será diferencial)

Formação - nível superior

Desejável - Certificação ITIL


Atuação: 100% Remota


Todas as nossas oportunidades de trabalho estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência.

Apoiamos a diversidade!

title: Windfarm Controller Commissioner
description:
Job description:

  • Global commissioning of Nordex groups wind farm controller (CWE & SGCS), mostly remote
  • Area of responsibility: commissioning of wind farm controller, controller interfaces and preparation of grid code testing
  • Regular contact and communication to the clients' experts to elaborate project-specific requirements, testing and solutions
  • Gain experiences of running and closing windfarm controller projects
  • Support of negotiations with customers, subcontractors and suppliers
  • Testing and improving processes within the Windfarm Control Operations department together with the department leads

As Windfarm Controller Commissioner, you will report directly to the group lead Windfarm Control Commissioning as disciplinary superior within Global PM/EPC – Windfarm Control Operations.

Job requirements:

  • University degree in Electrical Engineering, Technology, Electronics, IT, telecommunications or other equivalent technical education
  • Broad knowledge of wind farm controller tools and processes
  • Hardwired
  • Modbus TCP
  • IEC 60870-5-101
  • IEC 60870-5-104
  • OPC UA
  • DNP3
  • Grid operator interfaces and customer interfaces like:
  • Root cause analyses tools like wire shark
  • PLC commissioning
  • Grid Code Testing
  • PCMS - Parameter Configuration and Management System
  • Certificate to act as electrically skilled person is valuable
  • Knowledge about wind turbine technologies is beneficial
  • Self-responsible, structured and solution-oriented working
  • Very good communication skills, strong planning- and organizational skills
  • Fluency in English. Spanish and other languages are an added value
  • Intercultural understanding, ability to work productively in multitask teams and team player attitude
  • Willingness to go on business trips


The manufacture of wind farms in the onshore segment has been our main competence and passion for over 35 years. With more than 28 GW of installed capacity worldwide, our turbines provide sustainable energy to more than 80% of the global energy market and we are one of the largest companies in the wind sector. We are present in more than 25 markets and have production facilities in Germany, Spain, Brazil, USA, Mexico and India offering our more than 6,500 employees the opportunity for international and intercultural cooperation. We are growing and driving together the expansion of renewable energies around the world. If you wish, you can be part of our team. If you are passionate about renewable energies, you love working as a team and share our values of integrity, companionship, respect and entrepreneurship. We would like you to be part of it!

title: Supply Chain Manager - Food Manufacturing
description:
Please note: This role requires the successful candidate to relocate to Espiritu Santo, Vanuatu


Forney Enterprises is a leading kava manufacturing and export company with deep agribusiness roots, partnering directly with local farmers in the purchase of raw materials and contributing to the sustainable development of Vanuatu’s kava industry. As part of our long-term commitment to sustainability, community partnerships, and operational excellence, we are establishing a dedicated Supply Chain function within our business to strengthen this critical area and ensure the future of the industry.


The Role:

As Supply Chain Manager, you will be responsible for ensuring a consistent and sustainable supply of raw materials—particularly kava—while driving efficiency across procurement, warehousing, and logistics. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on agricultural expertise . You’ll build strong partnerships with farmers, oversee compliance with food safety and sustainability standards, and guide your team to deliver reliable supply chain performance.


While the primary focus is on strengthening supply chain systems and farmer engagement, there may also be opportunities to explore partnerships and international initiatives that further strengthen Vanuatu’s kava industry and contribute to its long-term sustainability.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement supply chain strategies that align with company goals and sustainability initiatives.
  • Oversee raw material procurement, focusing on kava sourcing, quality control, and supplier relationships.
  • Conduct farm visits to assess soil quality, cultivation practices, and compliance with sourcing standards.
  • Lead farmer engagement through roundtable meetings, promoting best practices and sustainable methods.
  • Manage warehouse operations, ensuring accurate inventory management, storage, and dispatch.
  • Provide leadership to Procurement Field Officers and Warehouse Supervisor.
  • Collaborate with QA, Finance, HR, and Logistics teams to achieve business targets.
  • Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies across procurement and logistics.
  • Drive continuous improvement through monitoring, analysis, and process optimisation.
  • Ensure compliance with food safety, GMP, and SQF certification standards.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Agriculture, Business, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years’ experience in supply chain, procurement, or agricultural sourcing (food or agribusiness preferred).
  • Knowledge of kava farming practices, soil quality, and agricultural supply chains (highly desirable).
  • Strong background in supplier engagement, contract management, and risk management.
  • Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional teams.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trusted farmer and supplier partnerships.
  • Demonstrated commitment to sustainability and rural development initiatives.


Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a growing business with international reach.
  • Contribute to the sustainable development of Vanuatu’s Kava Industry.
  • Lead a diverse team and make a lasting impact on both company operations and local farming communities.
  • Competitive remuneration package offered, with relocation support available for the right candidate.

description:
Business Analyst (TAX)


***Add resume in English***


Activities:


• Serves as a Tax, Sourcing, Travel, Expense, and Real Estate applications subject matter expert associated with functionality, content, processes, and procedures.

• Strong PC skills, including experience using MS Office Products, especially Excel and Project.

• Excellent organization skills, and verbal and written communication skills.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $6,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a security-conscious contract Senior level Software Engineer to help enhance the security posture of their applications. The primary focus of this role is to systematically reduce their attack surface by addressing high-priority security risks. Using Snyk as the primary scanning tool, this engineer will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and remediating dependencies with known exploitable vulnerabilities. The goal is a targeted reduction of risk, not a simple "update-all" approach.


Role & Responsibilities:

The engineer will be responsible for the following:

  • Vulnerability Analysis:  Analyze the results of Snyk scans of their codebases (Ruby, Go, Python, JavaScript).
  • Prioritization:  Critically assess Snyk reports to distinguish between theoretical vulnerabilities and those that are genuinely exploitable within the context of their applications.
  • Targeted Remediation:  Plan and execute targeted dependency upgrades or apply patches specifically to fix the prioritized exploitable vulnerabilities, ensuring minimal disruption to the system.
  • Code & Test Validation:  Refactor code and update unit/integration tests as necessary to support the upgraded dependencies and validate the fixes.
  • Collaboration & Documentation:  Work closely with internal security and engineering teams, participate in code reviews, and clearly document the rationale for each remediation.


Required Skills & Qualifications (Must-Haves):

Candidates must have demonstrable, hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • Security Tooling:  Proven professional experience using Snyk  to identify, prioritize, and manage vulnerabilities in a production environment. Candidate must be able to interpret Snyk's findings, including exploit maturity and reachability.
  • Strong professional experience with all of the following languages:

- Ruby (including Ruby on Rails)

- Go

- Python

- JavaScript

- TypeScript

  • Deep expertise with package managers for each ecosystem (e.g., package.json, Go Modules, Pip/Poetry, NPM/Yarn).
  • Version Control:  Expert-level proficiency with Git.
  • Automated Testing:  A strong commitment to quality with proven experience in writing comprehensive tests.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):

While not mandatory, preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

  • Other Security Tools:  Familiarity with other SAST/SCA tools (e.g., GitHub Advanced Security, Checkmarx, Trivy).
  • CI/CD Integration:  Experience integrating security tools like Snyk into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Containerization:  Experience with Docker and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position, allowing for work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to be a part of a mission-driven company that is committed to taking care of its employees.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $6,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a security-conscious contract Senior level Software Engineer to help enhance the security posture of their applications. The primary focus of this role is to systematically reduce their attack surface by addressing high-priority security risks. Using Snyk as the primary scanning tool, this engineer will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and remediating dependencies with known exploitable vulnerabilities. The goal is a targeted reduction of risk, not a simple "update-all" approach.


Role & Responsibilities:

The engineer will be responsible for the following:

  • Vulnerability Analysis:  Analyze the results of Snyk scans of their codebases (Ruby, Go, Python, JavaScript).
  • Prioritization:  Critically assess Snyk reports to distinguish between theoretical vulnerabilities and those that are genuinely exploitable within the context of their applications.
  • Targeted Remediation:  Plan and execute targeted dependency upgrades or apply patches specifically to fix the prioritized exploitable vulnerabilities, ensuring minimal disruption to the system.
  • Code & Test Validation:  Refactor code and update unit/integration tests as necessary to support the upgraded dependencies and validate the fixes.
  • Collaboration & Documentation:  Work closely with internal security and engineering teams, participate in code reviews, and clearly document the rationale for each remediation.


Required Skills & Qualifications (Must-Haves):

Candidates must have demonstrable, hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • Security Tooling:  Proven professional experience using Snyk  to identify, prioritize, and manage vulnerabilities in a production environment. Candidate must be able to interpret Snyk's findings, including exploit maturity and reachability.
  • Strong professional experience with all of the following languages:

- Ruby (including Ruby on Rails)

- Go

- Python

- JavaScript

- TypeScript

  • Deep expertise with package managers for each ecosystem (e.g., package.json, Go Modules, Pip/Poetry, NPM/Yarn).
  • Version Control:  Expert-level proficiency with Git.
  • Automated Testing:  A strong commitment to quality with proven experience in writing comprehensive tests.


Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):

While not mandatory, preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

  • Other Security Tools:  Familiarity with other SAST/SCA tools (e.g., GitHub Advanced Security, Checkmarx, Trivy).
  • CI/CD Integration:  Experience integrating security tools like Snyk into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Containerization:  Experience with Docker and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position, allowing for work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to be a part of a mission-driven company that is committed to taking care of its employees.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year
  • 10 paid days for local holidays


Work Schedule : US Eastern Standard Time


*Please note this role is currently for a 3-month project with the potential for a long-term position.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of full-stack software development experience and a background in React.js and React Native, as well as C#, C++, or .NET, to join our U.S. client's engineering team. In this role, you will utilize excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, as well as patience and a customer-friendly attitude, while working in a team environment.

The right candidate is someone who:

  • Solves problems
  • Enjoys diving into and modernizing a 30-year-old product
  • Drives high-quality industry and team standards
  • Loves learning new processes, terminology, concepts, and code
  • Displays a deep curiosity about how banking institutions function


Our client is a U.S. fintech software company that provides innovative banking solutions to enhance operations and improve members' financial lives. The company has grown steadily since its inception over thirty years ago, with nearly 300 financial institutions across the United States, U.S. territories, and the Caribbean as customers. Backed by a large private equity company, our client is a recognized market leader helmed by financial industry veterans.


Responsibilities

  • Modernize and transform the client's existing software and write new features for the client's customers
  • Document the client's processes, products, and APIs
  • Assist with software releases and ensure we remain on schedule
  • Participate in story pointing and estimation activities
  • Review code and provide feedback, as well as participate in pair programming
  • Be an Agile Scrum advocate
  • Write and maintain automated tests using tools such as Jest, Jasmine, Cypress, Telerik Test Studio, and Grafana k6


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Experience with the React Framework and React Native or equivalent JavaScript frameworks
  • Experience with a primary back-end language, such as C#, C++, or .NET
  • Experience working with databases, such as Progress OpenEdge, MySQL, Cassandra, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL
  • Background with Agile Scrum
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally
  • A strong product sense, a high degree of empathy for internal and external users, and a desire to seek feedback from the same users about your work
  • Understanding of development ergonomics, taking pride in understanding your engineering customers
  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and gets excited about collaboration to define complex problems better, determine solutions, and then execute on them
  • The ability to strike a balance between speed and quality of features to create durable technology. You thrive on building scalable systems that are robust, resilient to failure, and easy to maintain.
  • A practice of keeping up with industry trends and assessing new technologies that can help solve problems better
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of full-stack software development experience and a background in React.js and React Native, as well as C#, C++, or .NET, to join our U.S. client's engineering team. In this role, you will utilize excellent problem-solving, communication, and interpersonal skills, as well as patience and a customer-friendly attitude, while working in a team environment.

The right candidate is someone who:

  • Solves problems
  • Enjoys diving into and modernizing a 30-year-old product
  • Drives high-quality industry and team standards
  • Loves learning new processes, terminology, concepts, and code
  • Displays a deep curiosity about how banking institutions function


Our client is a U.S. fintech software company that provides innovative banking solutions to enhance operations and improve members' financial lives. The company has grown steadily since its inception over thirty years ago, with nearly 300 financial institutions across the United States, U.S. territories, and the Caribbean as customers. Backed by a large private equity company, our client is a recognized market leader helmed by financial industry veterans.


Responsibilities

  • Modernize and transform the client's existing software and write new features for the client's customers
  • Document the client's processes, products, and APIs
  • Assist with software releases and ensure we remain on schedule
  • Participate in story pointing and estimation activities
  • Review code and provide feedback, as well as participate in pair programming
  • Be an Agile Scrum advocate
  • Write and maintain automated tests using tools such as Jest, Jasmine, Cypress, Telerik Test Studio, and Grafana k6


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Experience with the React Framework and React Native or equivalent JavaScript frameworks
  • Experience with a primary back-end language, such as C#, C++, or .NET

  • Background with Agile Scrum

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity and gets excited about collaboration to define complex problems better, determine solutions, and then execute on them
  • The ability to strike a balance between speed and quality of features to create durable technology. You thrive on building scalable systems that are robust, resilient to failure, and easy to maintain.

title: Regional Data Visualization & BI Specialist
description:
Esta posición es clave para traducir datos en historias comprensibles a través de dashboards interactivos y efectivos. Como Data Visualization & BI Specialist serás responsable de diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards enfocados en la toma de decisiones para un cliente estratégico de IPG Mediabrands. Colaborarás estrechamente con ingenieros de datos, project managers y equipos de cliente para definir soluciones de visualización que generen impacto. Esta posición reporta directamente al Regional BI Manager y forma parte de una red regional comprometida con elevar el estándar de nuestras capacidades en visualización.




Responsabilidades clave


  • Diseñar y desarrollar dashboards efectivos y atractivos utilizando PowerBI principalmente.
  • Transformar y preparar datos utilizando Power Query desde diversas fuentes como BigQuery, APIs y archivos planos.
  • Desarrollar métricas complejas y cálculos con DAX alineados a los objetivos del cliente.
  • Administrar, actualizar y optimizar dashboards en producción, resolviendo incidentes en colaboración con los equipos técnicos.
  • Colaborar con Data Engineers para definir modelos de datos que respalden las necesidades de visualización.
  • Capacitar a usuarios finales y promover las mejores prácticas de visualización dentro del cliente y del equipo interno.
  • Documentar procesos y soluciones para asegurar escalabilidad y reutilización.
  • Contribuir al desarrollo y evolución de nuestras capacidades de visualización en instancias locales y regionales.


Cualificaciones Esenciales


  • +5 años de experiencia comprobable diseñando dashboards en PowerBI, con un portafolio sólido que demuestre excelencia visual y analítica.
  • Dominio de Power Query para tareas de transformación de datos.
  • Sólidos conocimientos en DAX para la creación de KPIs y lógica analítica.
  • Conocimientos en modelado de datos y principios de UX/UI aplicados a visualización.
  • Manejo de BigQuery y lenguaje SQL.
  • Habilidad para comunicar resultados a públicos técnicos y no técnicos.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos ágiles.



Habilidades y características deseadas


  • Experiencia previa en la industria de medios o publicidad, especialmente en canales digitales como redes sociales o publicidad programática. (NO EXCLUYENTE)
  • Conocimiento en administración de espacios de trabajo en PowerBI y optimización de rendimiento.
  • Pasión por la innovación, iniciativa para aprender nuevas tecnologías de BI y compartir conocimientos con el equipo.

title: Revenue Operations Specialist
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Revenue Operations Specialist with 3 to 6 years of experience in revenue and sales operations to support our U.S. client's growing go-to-market organization. You will be responsible for managing and improving processes that drive revenue visibility and efficiency, including Salesforce administration, pipeline analytics, quote-to-cash workflows, and services operations coordination.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Services, and Systems, ensuring operational excellence across the full customer lifecycle. The ideal candidate is a systems thinker who thrives on process optimization, data accuracy, and cross-functional collaboration.

Our client provides a cloud-based ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers, delivering market-leading software solutions for field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land management. Backed by private equity, our client accelerates business performance, improves operational efficiency, and reduces costs.


Responsibilities

  • Sales Operations
  • Own and optimize Salesforce processes for the Sales and Account Management teams, including lead management, opportunity tracking, forecasting, and pipeline hygiene
  • Partner with Sales Leadership to develop and maintain dashboards, metrics, and reports that provide visibility into bookings performance, funnel conversion, and forecast accuracy
  • Support commission plan execution by maintaining accurate opportunity data, product configurations, and close dates
  • Coordinate with Finance and Legal on deal review processes, ensuring consistency between quotes, contracts, and billing data
  • Services Operations
  • Support Professional Services leadership with project setup, time tracking, and revenue recognition workflows in coordination with Finance
  • Track utilization, backlog, and project profitability metrics to ensure delivery teams have accurate performance visibility
  • Partner with the Project Management Office (PMO) and Delivery to standardize statements of work (SOWs), rate cards, and project milestone tracking
  • Drive continuous improvement in services data quality across CRM, PSA, and billing systems
  • CRM and Systems Administration
  • Serve as the Salesforce (SFDC) administrator for all go-to-market (GTM) functions - including user management, profiles, validation rules, and custom workflows
  • Maintain integrations with related systems to ensure data synchronization and process automation
  • Implement enhancements and new functionality as business requirements evolve, documenting changes and training users accordingly
  • Manage user support requests, troubleshoot data discrepancies, and ensure compliance with data governance standards
  • Data and Reporting
  • Develop recurring and ad hoc reports to support revenue forecasting, KPI reviews, and board-level insights
  • Audit data for accuracy and completeness across systems; proactively resolve inconsistencies or bottlenecks
  • Partner with finance, sales, and marketing leadership to define and monitor core GTM metrics, including customer acquisition cost (CAC) payback, annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth, churn, and expansion rates.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
  • 3 to 6 years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or similar analytical GTM roles
  • Advanced proficiency with Salesforce CRM
  • Experience with SaaS business models, including ARR tracking, renewals, and professional services revenue workflows
  • Strong Excel and reporting skills
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills with a bias for action and detail orientation
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Master of Business Administration degree
  • Salesforce administration certification
  • Familiarity with HubSpot, NetSuite, or PSA tools (e.g., Mavenlink, Kantata, FinancialForce)
  • Power BI or Tableau experience
  • Experience with oil and gas revenue accounting, gas processing, crude/gas/NGL transportation, or related fields


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Senior Web Designer
description:
We’re looking for an experienced and creative Web Designer to join our fully remote team to work on a variety of projects for our clients across the globe.


Overview


Wunderdogs is an independent creative agency based in San Francisco, California with a growing distributed team across the U.S., Canada and Europe. We provide beginning-to-end design, production and strategy services to forward-thinking brands in the technology space, from startups to established companies.

From one-off-digital projects to full website designs, no two Wunderdogs jobs are the same: if you’re a creative who enjoys variety in what you do the diverse nature of our work is sure to keep you on your toes. We’re looking for a designer excited by the opportunity to support our team on our digital creative and elevate our work to the next level.


Websites form a core part of our business therefore a passion for and extensive experience in web design is a must. Our ideal candidate will have a strong visual sense, an analytical mind, a good eye for detail and the portfolio to back it up.


We’re looking for someone who does not shy away from a challenge and is comfortable working to tight deadlines when required. You will be joining us during an exciting time and will be working on multiple projects simultaneously, often for different clients. Our team is entrepreneurial, smart, hard working and fun - Wunderdogs is a challenging yet very rewarding workplace, one where your effort and passion can make a real difference to our clients.


Your key day-to-day responsibilities will include


  • Conceptualizing creative ideas with clients
  • Testing and improving the design of the website
  • Establishing design guidelines, standards, and best practices
  • Maintaining the appearance of websites by enforcing content standards
  • Designing visual imagery for websites and ensuring that they are in line with branding for clients.
  • Effectively communicate your designs to developers and other key stakeholders
  • Address product, marketing and business needs
  • Conduct industry research and stay up-to-date on best practices, competitor UI designs and emerging technologies
  • Facilitate web workshops for our clients
  • Create lo-fi wireframes and high-fidelity designs in Figma
  • Develop design systems, design websites using brand guidelines
  • Communicate with clients and attend client meetings
  • Collaborate with developers to design new and intuitive user experiences
  • Interact with our development and management teams to collaborate on pitches and strategies


The Qualifications


  • 4-5 years of design industry experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in graphic design or similar field and a strong portfolio of digital projects
  • Fluent across the Adobe Creative Suite and Figma
  • Understanding of design systems and how to create them
  • Understanding of Figma and how to use it
  • Great communication skills: whether it’s talking through your work with the team or speaking with clients, you’ll need to be able to get your point across and empathize with those of others
  • Experience creating products with complex user flows and high-quality UI design is a plus
  • Experience running stakeholder workshops with clients
  • Ability to work at least 3-4 business hours in Pacific Standard Time
  • Self-motivation in a remote professional environment and ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Sharp attention to detail within a fast-paced work environment


The Perks


  • Diverse team and interesting projects from all over the globe
  • KPI-based yearly bonus
  • Fully remote job (traveling is encouraged)
  • Highly cooperative team that encourages professional growth and self-development
  • Salary is commensurate with experience


How to apply


To be considered, send your cover letter, CV, case studies, portfolio, references and any supporting materials to

TradeSuite by Astéria – 100% remoto | CLT


A Astéria Tech está em plena expansão, impulsionada pelo crescimento da sua unidade de negócios TradeSuite , e buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack Pleno para integrar nosso time de tecnologia.

Se você gosta de explorar soluções com Inteligência Artificial , tem experiência em projetos SaaS , atua em iniciativas para grandes indústrias e varejo e deseja fazer parte de um ambiente inovador, colaborativo e em constante crescimento , essa oportunidade é para você!


RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Desenvolver, aprimorar e manter aplicações web em ambiente SaaS , além de projetos sob medida para diferentes clientes.
  • Colaborar de forma próxima com os times de produto e design, transformando requisitos em soluções funcionais e escaláveis.
  • Atuar ativamente em code reviews, garantindo boas práticas de versionamento e aderência a metodologias ágeis.
  • Contribuir para a cultura de inovação e excelência , fortalecendo o crescimento contínuo da equipe e da empresa.


REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS


Tecnologias – Obrigatório

  • GIT, .NET Core 5+, Angular 13+
  • SQL, Bootstrap 4+, SASS/SCSS


Tecnologias – Desejável

  • .NET Framework 4.5+, AngularJS, LESS


Ferramentas – Obrigatório

  • VS Community, VS Code
  • SQL Server Management Studio
  • Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Microsoft 365 (SharePoint, OneDrive)
  • Bitbucket, NPM


Ferramentas – Desejável


  • gitFork, Github Copilot, Power Automate, Figma
  • Azure DevOps, Node, PowerShell


O QUE OFERECEMOS


  • Regime de contratação: CLT
  • Trabalho 100% remoto
  • Faixa salarial: a combinar
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Vale-refeição
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Seguro de vida
  • Equipamento de trabalho
  • Part-time off no aniversário com voucher de presente
  • Incentivo em cursos/treinamento


NOSSA CULTURA


Na Astéria , acreditamos que excelência tecnológica deve caminhar junto com integridade, colaboração e inovação contínua. Somos guiados por valores como respeito, empatia, integridade e responsabilidade , sempre colocando pessoas em primeiro lugar .

Nosso ambiente de trabalho é inclusivo, transparente e voltado para resultados sustentáveis. Valorizamos profissionais que gostam de aprender, compartilhar conhecimento e inovar para transformar ideias em soluções de alto impacto.

Aqui, cada voz importa. Nosso time é movido pela paixão em criar soluções que ajudem empresas a alcançarem seu máximo potencial, em um espaço que promove equilíbrio, autonomia e desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional.


COMO SE CANDIDATAR


Envie seu currículo e/ou portfólio para com o assunto: “Vaga Fullstack Pleno – TradeSuite”.

title: Quality Assurance Lead Automotive
description:
Are you fascinated by e-mobility, infotainment, telematics, and cutting-edge automotive technologies? Would you like to contribute to these areas as a Quality Assurance Lead Automotive and take on a key role in driving innovative solutions forward? If so, we’d love to hear from you!

To strengthen our consulting team for a premium car manufacturer, we are looking for a skilled Quality Assurance Lead Automotive to join our international team. In this role, you will lead and coordinate quality efforts, applying innovative approaches and technologies to ensure KPIs are achieved, while effectively communicating results to key stakeholders in the automotive sector.

If you are passionate about software and system testing, experienced in managing test strategies and teams, and eager to contribute to cutting-edge solutions as part of a diverse, collaborative team spread across multiple global locations, this opportunity is for you!

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead independent technical analysis, documentation and elimination of reported issues.
  • End-to-end support with troubleshooting issues and communicating resolutions to the specific departments.
  • Responsible for organization and coordination of test campaigns.
  • Ensure the quality of the tickets raised, act and escalate in case of problems.
  • Proper documentation of errors and implemented solutions in the database.
  • Manage the Problem Management System.
  • Measure KPIs and create reports.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
  • High interest in digital features, systems and connectivity in the automotive sector.
  • Desirable: knowledge in automotive electronics and bus systems (CAN, Ethernet, LIN…) and agile methodologies and tools (Confluence, Jira).
  • Proficient in IT tools.
  • ITIL knowledge is beneficial.
  • Fluent English. German is a plus.

BENEFITS

  • Individual guidance and mentoring from the start, personal development to improve your professional growth.
  • Working with the latest technology and state-of-the-art equipment.
  • Short- and long-term international opportunities.
  • We support your health with attractive offers like gym subsidies, health workshops, sport events...
  • We support, offer and cover the cost of language courses from level A1 to C1.

Apply now!

Pixida is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer! We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires and respects all individuals and in which all aspects of employment are applied without discrimination. Therefore, we encourage all individuals to apply! Please provide your CV (already with certificates, employer's references, etc.) In addition, we ask you to provide information about your possible start date, salary expectations and language skills.

title: Full Stack Developer "982043"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Angular no front-end.
  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar bancos de dados SQL para dar suporte à funcionalidade das aplicações.
  • Criar e manter APIs em Python , garantindo integração eficiente entre o front-end e o back-end.
  • Utilizar o Azure Data Factory para integração e transformação de dados.
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais para definir, desenhar e implementar novas funcionalidades.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e debug em toda a stack de desenvolvimento.
  • Assegurar a performance, qualidade e responsividade das aplicações.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias do setor, buscando melhorias contínuas nos processos de desenvolvimento.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada como Full Stack Developer ou função similar.
  • Forte proficiência em Angular para desenvolvimento front-end.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e administração de bancos de dados SQL .
  • Proficiência em Python para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com Azure Data Factory .
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de controle de versão (ex: GitHub).
  • Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).
  • Inglês avançado


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem (Azure, AWS).
  • Conhecimento em outros frameworks front-end (React, Vue.js).
  • Entendimento de práticas DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD .


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.


Modelo de trabalho

CLT

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando Angular no front-end.
  • Projetar, implementar e gerenciar bancos de dados SQL para dar suporte à funcionalidade das aplicações.
  • Criar e manter APIs em Python , garantindo integração eficiente entre o front-end e o back-end.
  • Utilizar o Azure Data Factory para integração e transformação de dados.
  • Colaborar com times multifuncionais para definir, desenhar e implementar novas funcionalidades.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e debug em toda a stack de desenvolvimento.
  • Assegurar a performance, qualidade e responsividade das aplicações.
  • Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias do setor, buscando melhorias contínuas nos processos de desenvolvimento.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada como Full Stack Developer ou função similar.
  • Forte proficiência em Angular para desenvolvimento front-end.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento e administração de bancos de dados SQL .
  • Proficiência em Python para desenvolvimento de APIs.
  • Experiência prática com Azure Data Factory .
  • Familiaridade com sistemas de controle de versão (ex: GitHub).
  • Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.
  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas (ou experiência equivalente).
  • Inglês avançado


Será um destaque seu perfil com

  • Experiência com plataformas em nuvem (Azure, AWS).
  • Conhecimento em outros frameworks front-end (React, Vue.js).
  • Entendimento de práticas DevOps e pipelines de CI/CD .


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.


Modelo de trabalho

CLT

title: [Remote] Senior Software Engineer (Java)
description:
Location: Remote (New Zealand time zone overlap preferred)

Type: Contractor / Full-Time

Hours: Flexible, with at least 3–4 hours of overlap with NZT (18h-22h BRT)

Start Date: Immediate


About the role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years of experience in Java and strong working knowledge of Node.js and Python . This role goes beyond traditional development—you’ll be expected to embrace AI as part of your daily toolkit , using it to improve efficiency, generate insights, and accelerate delivery.


You’ll work across a variety of projects, including green-field builds where you’ll own architecture and design decisions, collaborating directly with clients to shape solutions from concept through delivery.


Responsibilities

  • Architect and deliver scalable, secure, and performant solutions in green-field and ongoing projects.
  • Build applications in Java, Node.js and Python .
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT, Cursor, AI debugging tools, etc) to speed up development, improve documentation, and optimise workflows.
  • Collaborate directly with clients to gather requirements, provide technical guidance, and deliver value.
  • Define engineering best practices, technical roadmaps, and solution design standards.
  • Mentor engineers and foster a culture of experimentation, quality, and continuous learning.


Requirements

  • 10+ years of professional experience in software engineering with strong Java expertise.
  • Working knowledge of Node.js and Python .
  • Proven experience architecting and delivering green-field projects.
  • Strong grasp of cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Comfortable and proactive in using AI tools for coding, documentation, testing, and prototyping .
  • Excellent communication skills in English, written and spoken.
  • Ability to work directly with clients in a consultative and collaborative manner.


Desirable

  • Experience in high-autonomy/startup environments.
  • Familiarity with microservices, Docker/Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
  • Exposure to AI/ML project work (bonus but not required).


What we offer

  • International projects with heavy use of AI-assisted workflows.
  • A role where you can architect solutions from the ground up.
  • Flexible, remote work environment built on trust.
  • A small, collaborative, and forward-thinking technical team.
  • Real opportunities to influence product direction and company decisions.


Company Description

TechVantage Solutions is a New Zealand-based software consultancy specializing in software development outsourcing and engineering team augmentation. We empower businesses from fast-moving startups to global enterprises to build, scale, and deliver high-quality software with speed and confidence. We have partnered with companies around the world, including those serving Fortune 500 clients, to solve complex technical challenges and accelerate delivery. At TechVantage, we bridge the gap between business and technology, delivering scalable, world-class solutions from New Zealand.

title: Desenvolvimento de Negócios Globais - Especialistas em Varejo
description:
Se você já liderou no varejo - na loja ou na sede - queremos falar com você.


Sim, somos uma empresa de tecnologia.


Não, você não precisa ter experiência em tecnologia.


Na STOREE.AI, criamos uma plataforma que permite que os gerentes se dupliquem em uma versão com inteligência artificial - um gêmeo digital capaz de liderar equipes, atribuir tarefas, acompanhar KPIs e treinar colaboradores.


Já somos utilizados por mais de 100 redes de lojas.


A tecnologia funciona.


Agora precisamos de pessoas que entendem de varejo para ajudar outros a entender como fazer isso funcionar para eles.


Por que a experiência em varejo é importante:


Nossa plataforma é ampla - ela pode fazer muita coisa.


Mas o que funciona bem para uma rede pode ser completamente diferente para outra.


Uma rede de cosméticos precisa de ferramentas diferentes das de um supermercado.


Um diretor de VM enxerga valor em funcionalidades diferentes das que importam para um head de RH ou de operações.


É por isso que não queremos vendedores.


Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:


  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos


Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.


O que você vai realmente fazer:


  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo


Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.


Para quem é essa oportunidade:


  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira


Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.


É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria


Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.

title: Profissional Product Designer – Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 54312


Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


  • Ei #fera em design de produto, chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos por #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- O que você deve ter?


  • +4 anos de experiência em design digital, com portfólio demonstrando projetos end-to-end.
  • Fluência em Espanhol (oral e escrito) para conduzir pesquisas e apresentações com usuários e stakeholders.
  • Experiência comprovada na construção de jornadas do usuário E2E.
  • Domínio de UX research, UX design e UI design, com foco em entregar experiências consistentes e escaláveis.
  • Excelência na prototipação em alta fidelidade (Figma, Sketch, ou ferramentas similares)
  • Capacidade de estruturar e defender escopos de projeto de design.


Atuação para time Global, por isso, a fluência no idioma Espanhol é imprescindível.


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!
